name: Slide Commit
description: Slide-to-confirm control with a draggable handle that springs back if released early and commits when dragged to the end, with pending spinner, success and error states.
contents: Dark track with a centered hint label
Draggable handle with arrow icon that becomes a spinner, then a check with a done label
Error label shown in the track on failure
behavior: Handle follows the pointer and springs back with a bounce when released before the end
Reaching the end calls onConfirm; a returned promise shows a spinner for at least 300ms
Success turns the handle green with a check and done label, then resets after holdMs
Rejected promise or thrown error turns the handle red, shakes the track and shows the error label
Handle squashes when pulled backwards and swells slightly on mouse hover
Keyboard support with arrow keys, Home, End and Escape, as an ARIA slider
Reduced motion replaces springs with short eases
editableByProps: Labels for idle, success and error states
Track, handle, success and error colors
Size, corner radius, spring speed, bounce and landing dip
How long the success state is held
Disabled state, custom handle icon, confirm, done and error callbacks

needsCodeEdit.change: Change handle padding inside the track
Change the success check icon or spinner

fixed: Fixed pixel width and height, not responsive to the container; keep width within the viewport on small screens
Drag is horizontal left to right only and uses touch-none on the track
Hover swell only applies to mouse on fine pointer devices
Injects a style tag with the spinner keyframes
Reaching 100% travel commits; a partial drag always returns
Reduced motion preference is read from the system, not a prop
Aria labels and the live region text ('Working') are hardcoded
